skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Creates design philosophies and turns them into polished visual artifacts as PNG, PDF, and Markdown outputs.
skill.summary: Builds design-forward posters, art pieces, and visual documents from a user brief.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives from font license text, Markdown backticks, design prose, or expected font binaries. The bundled fonts parsed as TrueType files during manual review. Two semantic risks remain: a fabricated prior-user instruction and an unconstrained external font download instruction.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the claim that the user already said a specific sentence. Ask the agent to refine only when the actual user requests refinement.
Use bundled fonts by default. Require explicit user approval and trusted sources before downloading any new font files.
Publish source URLs and checksums for bundled fonts so reviewers can verify them during future marketplace scans.

content.value_statement: Design briefs often need a clear visual direction before production. This skill creates a design philosophy and renders polished PNG or PDF artwork.
actual_capabilities: Drafts a concise visual philosophy from a user brief.
Creates one-page design-forward PNG or PDF artifacts.
Uses bundled font files to vary typography.
Keeps text minimal and treats it as a visual element.
Supports multi-page visual sequences when requested.
Outputs a matching Markdown design philosophy.
limitations: It does not guarantee print-ready commercial production files.
External font downloads require user and environment approval.
Bundled font binaries should remain subject to marketplace file scanning.
It should not copy living artists or protected artwork.

use_cases.title: Prototype Art Direction
use_cases.description: Create a visual philosophy and a polished first poster for a campaign concept.

use_cases.title: Create Editorial Artwork
use_cases.description: Turn an article theme into a restrained visual artifact for review or publication planning.

use_cases.title: Explore Event Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate a design-forward PDF or PNG for posters, venue graphics, or abstract announcements.

prompt_templates.title: Single Poster
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one static asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-page PNG poster for [topic]. Use minimal text, strong composition, and a clear visual philosophy.

prompt_templates.title: Brand Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a design philosophy for [brand or event], then create a PDF artwork using these colors: [colors]. Include only essential words.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Page Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-page PDF visual sequence for [subject]. Each page should share one philosophy but use distinct compositions.

prompt_templates.title: Refined Art Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a polished PNG for [audience] about [theme]. Avoid imitation, document the philosophy, and refine spacing, typography, and margins.

output_examples.input: Create a poster about urban gardening with minimal text.
output: A Markdown design philosophy focused on organic structure and restrained typography.
A one-page PNG poster with abstract planting forms, sparse labels, and balanced margins.

output_examples.input: Design a three-page abstract PDF for a jazz festival.
output: A shared visual philosophy for rhythm, restraint, and typographic movement.
A three-page PDF sequence with distinct layouts and consistent art direction.

output_examples.input: Make a launch visual for a ceramics studio.
output_examples.output: A quiet PDF artwork with tactile forms, minimal text, and a matching philosophy document.

best_practices: Provide the subject, audience, output format, and page count.
State any brand colors, required words, or prohibited references.
Approve external font downloads only from trusted sources.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to imitate a specific artist's protected style.
Do not request dense explanatory text inside the artwork.
Do not allow arbitrary font downloads in restricted environments.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a design philosophy document and a PNG or PDF visual artifact.

faq.question: Can it create multiple pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports multi-page PDF or PNG sequences when the user asks for them.

faq.question: Does it use bundled fonts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes local font files and can use them for varied typography.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: Not for bundled fonts. External font downloads should require explicit approval.

faq.question: Can it copy a known artist style?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs the agent to create original designs and avoid copying artists.

faq.question: Is it safe for restricted environments?
faq.answer: Use it with warnings. Disable external downloads and review bundled font binaries before deployment.
